card.title: Nintendo Switch No Fan Spin Voltage Injection Method

source.title: Nintendo Switch No Fan Spin Voltage Injection Method

claims.statement: With the console on, tapping 2.5–3.5 V into the fan's VCC pin for 1–2 s a few times can revive the open MOSFET that feeds fan and Joy-Con rails (credited to TheCod3r).
Replace a fan that resists, grinds or whines before trying this.

procedure: Confirm the fan never spins under load.
With console on, tap 2.5–3.5 V into fan VCC for 1–2 s, repeat.
Stop when it spins; check Joy-Con charging; replace MOSFET if no luck.
card.caveats: Community method; source claims high success. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
